lines.2: All right, made it to school on time today.
lines.3: 「I'm feeling kind of horny today, so it's gonna rain.」
lines.4: 「That's the worst weather forecast I've ever heard.」
lines.5: The surprising thing was, he tended to be right.
lines.6: 「Huh? Come to think of it, is Fukahire out today? He skips school a fair bit.」
